audience: general adults beginning a supervised fitness routine

evidence_summary.typical_result: modest improvements in strength and exercise confidence with wide individual variation

approved_prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: realistic fitness campaign image. Create a natural editorial photograph of three diverse adults with ordinary, realistic body shapes doing beginner resistance-band exercises with a qualified coach in a bright community fitness studio. Show comfortable workout clothing, attainable effort, supportive instruction, and natural skin texture. Wide landscape composition with clear negative space for separately approved copy. No before-and-after layout, no body reshaping, no weight-loss implication, no extreme muscularity, no measurements, no outcome labels, no text, no logos, and no watermark.
